paper_title: Ultralight Dark Matter Search with Space-Time Separated Atomic Clocks and Cavities
notes: Headline result: first constraints on the scalar-DM-electron coupling d_me alone for m_phi in 1e-19 to 2e-15 eV. Curve is the lower boundary (smallest excluded |d_me|) of the combined excluded region in Fig. 2 right panel, which is the union of two 'this work' regions: GPS microwave-clock (darker orange, the deeper/stronger part reaching log10|d_me|~2 over ~1.6e-19 to 6e-17 eV) and NPL/PTB cavity-cavity (lighter orange, reaching log10|d_me|~4.5 over ~6e-17 to 2e-15 eV). Envelope digitized from the rasterized combined.pdf (no ancillary data table shipped); axes calibrated from vector tick-label bboxes (x=log10(m_phi/eV), y=log10|d_me|). The steep left cap near 1e-19 eV (log|d_me|~6.5) and the near-vertical GPS->Cavities step near 6e-17 eV are real features of the two-experiment envelope. 95% confidence level; scalar-DM search assumes rho_DM ~= 0.4 GeV/cm^3 (paper's value, incl. stochastic factor xi~1/3). kappa=sqrt(4pi)/M_Pl convention matches the canonical d_me definition, so no conversion applied.
